Transaction complete.

## Audit result

No P12/P13 contradictions remain. Surviving `counters only` text is only the deliberate reconciliation wording (spec superseding clause + task .2's explicit "not counters only"); `/tmp/fn112-baseline/` now appears only where named as scratch storage. Spec, task .2 (channel owner), .3 (hook emitters + unit acceptance), and .6 (QA protocol) share one field set and one invariant set; task .7's final gate and both acceptance lists cite the durable receipt by path and `capture_id`. Two stale `/tmp`-authoritative citations in task .7 and four bare "vs baseline" tails in .3/.4/.5/.6 were the only fixes needed.

## Dispositions

**P12** — one executable schema (`seq`, `t`, `docId`, `pageNumber`, `taskId`, `genId`, `kind`, `outcome`, `scale`, `canvasWidth/Height`) with opaque, content-free identifiers; invariants for exactly-one-terminal-settle, cancel→cancelled-settle→replacement-start ordering, and non-decreasing `genId`; bounded ring buffer with a visible `dropped` counter plus `reset({capacity})`/`snapshot()`/`export()`; QA windows reset first, read snapshots, and must assert `dropped === 0`. Unit acceptance added in .2 (schema, monotonicity, privacy, retention) and .3 (correlation, orphans, ordering, churn retention).

**P13** — durable `.flow/reviews/fn-112-baseline-receipt.json` (+ `.md`) written in task .2 step 0 before any edit, recording per-command string/exit/duration/counts/enumerated failures/log sha256+path plus base SHA, branch, Bun/tsc/platform, timestamps, environment notes; regeneration via isolated `git worktree add --detach` at the exact base SHA with `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in that worktree only, appended as a new `regenerated: true` capture; R17 compares against the named failure list and cites receipt + `capture_id`. Nothing was executed.
